protocol.purpose: Paired retrospective thermal-observation comparison; no retraining or threshold tuning
protocol.selection: All completed exact-cluster-linked runs in the previously retrieved 500-run archive whose floor-hour issue plus six hours is before the local raw-archive end. Retain cases with no subsequent detections; do not select by outcome.
protocol.cohort: Future dates relative to training cutoff; familiar geographic regions are explicitly marked, not described as geographic holdouts
protocol.model_input_time: Last whole hour at/before DeepFire creation, using exact frozen trainer and original hourly feature builder. Model input age in minutes is reported; no data newer than that hour enters model inputs. Fixed patch centre is the saved simulation origin.
protocol.target_time: After DeepFire creation (first scheduled 10-minute scan at/after it) until model_issue+3h or +6h, common absolute endpoint. Exclude all previously positive cells before that start from novel score. This common residual window is slightly shorter than nominal model horizon.
protocol.label: Native MTG quality flag positive if 1/2 ever in window; negative only if every scheduled scan is 0; other cells censored. Frozen pre-training persistent heat prior excluded.
protocol.roi: Primary 20 km radius around saved ignition origin; 10 km sensitivity. Model consumes full native 64x64 patch.
protocol.primary_mask: Cells with observable model history and no detected fire in previous 3h through DeepFire creation, excluding persistent heat prior. Future quality controls label validity only.
protocol.deepfire: Saved hourly polygons; union polygons through floor/ceil relative hour bracketing common endpoint. Rasterize on same native grid using any intersection (all_touched). Both timing bounds reported; fraction of pixel coverage is not called a calibrated probability.
protocol.aggregation: Pooled cell-forecast counts and equal-cluster summaries, not thousands of independent fires
protocol.baselines: Persistence and fixed 2-native-pixel dilation from model-time observed state; no target-based tuning
limitations: Thermal detection benchmark, not physical burned-area or evacuation validation
Unequal underlying sensors and weather; DeepFire is newer by up to one hour
DeepFire forecast area does not directly represent probability of satellite detection
Single frozen model seed; no model promotion
